description.value: Toro's Liquor Store is a well-established Vernon bottle shop with over 45 years of experience, carrying more than 450 beers, 800+ spirits, and 1,100+ wines with an emphasis on Okanagan regional producers. It offers personalized staff guidance and a curated focus on local craft breweries, artisanal cideries, and regional vineyards. Touring cyclists could use it as a resupply stop for locally sourced beverages to enjoy at camp or a destination accommodation.

address.value: 1220 Kalamalka Lake Rd, Vernon, BC V1T 6V2
